description: Add an episode to a season, numbered after the last one, as a draft with no video. Title, synopsis, runtime and a buy/rent price for this episode alone are optional. Up to 200 per season. Then start_film_upload with asset: episode and the returned episode id for its video, and publish_episode once the video is ready and the season is published. An episode added by mistake is removed only in the film editor, so check the season with the user first.

access.description: free = Free to watch, paid = Buy or rent, for this episode; null = the same as its season (the default).

buy_price.description: Buy price for this episode in US cents (minimum 100); null removes it. Only sells once the episode is published.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

keep_as_draft.description: true = Keep as draft: Publish and Save changes leave this episode alone until it is set back to false (only for an episode never released). Cannot be combined with a release_at.

release_at.description: Release on a date: an ISO 8601 date-time with a time zone (e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00Z). Until then, once published, the series page shows the episode with its date: it can be bought or rented ahead (a pre-order) and nobody can watch it; it comes out by itself at that time. The season's and the series' own release dates hold it too (the latest one decides). null = release with the next Publish / Save changes. An episode that is already out cannot be moved into the future.

rent_price.description: Rental price for this episode in US cents (minimum 100); null removes it.

rental_window_hours.description: How long an episode rental lasts, in hours.

runtime_minutes.description: Runtime in minutes, used only until the episode has a video (its own length wins); null clears it.

synopsis.description: The episode's synopsis; null clears it.

title.description: The episode's title (up to 200 characters); null clears it, leaving "Episode N".

name: add_episode
title: Add an episode
